items.statement: Studded mix at ~55% in Q4 (down from ~68% in FY25); exit rate expected near 60% as gold prices stabilize

items.statement: FY28 AUM growth guidance of 23-25% CAGR from FY25 base reaffirmed; on track

items.statement: FY27 cost of funds expected to be lower than FY26 due to liability repricing

items.statement: NIMs expected to improve in FY27 driven by faster growth in high-yield segments (unsecured, motor finance, affordable housing)
items.quote: So as far as margins are concerned we expect them to improve in the coming year because quarter 4 also is better for us on margins compared to the full year.

items.statement: Unsecured retail AUM at 10.3%, targeting 15%; expect mix to inch up by ~1% in FY27
items.quote: With unsecured retail currently at 10.3% of AUM, we continue to see significant headroom towards our target of scaling this to 15% and we remain firmly on track to achieve this.

items.statement: Motor Finance disbursements planned to grow ~80% YoY in FY27; book growth ~10% due to matured book repayments
items.quote: Our disbursements will grow at close to about 80% plus, that's what we have planned in next year . But because of the matured book there are a lot of repayments also which are happening. Consequently the book growth will be lower.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 disbursements crossed INR50,000 crores for first time, up 32% YoY and 12% QoQ
items.quote: Quarter four set a new benchmark with disbursements crossing INR50,000 crores, a first for the company and a testament to our growing scale.

items.statement: Net total income stable at 6.5% in Q4 FY26; daily average NIM shows 10 bps improvement vs 2-point average
items.quote: We continue to operate with stable margin corridor with Net total income in quarter 4 at 6.5%.

items.statement: No material stress observed in portfolio from West Asia conflict; caution focused on MSME working capital cycles
items.quote: As far as risk from geo -political environment is concerned, we have not observed any material stress in our portfolio across commercial vehicle as well as MSME segments.

items.statement: Housing finance AUM grew 29% YoY to INR86,653 cr; expect similar pace in FY27; affordable housing growing faster
items.quote: Our housing finance company, that's grown at a bout 29% to 30%. So that growth has been robust and we believe that we will be able to continue the same going forward too.

items.statement: Housing finance cost-to-income improved ~320 bps YoY to 31.1% in FY26; dropped below 30% in Q4
items.quote: Our focus on automation, Gen AI, and tighter operational control has resulted in improvement of cost to income ratio by ~320 basis points from 34.3% in FY25 to 31.1% in FY26.

items.statement: Consolidated credit cost improved to 0.9% in Q4 FY26 (down 30 bps QoQ); FY26 credit cost 1.2% vs 1.4% in FY25
items.quote: Credit costs improved to 0.9%, down ~30 basis points from quarter three of FY26

items.statement: Motor Finance achieved breakeven in Q3 FY26, PAT INR43 cr in Q4; AUM INR25,390 cr (down 4% QoQ) due to fitness-first approach
items.quote: As you would remember, we achieved a breakeven in Motor Finance business in quarter 3 of FY26. Backed by seasonal strength and lower credit costs, profit after tax for quarter 4 in Motor Finance business was INR43 crores.

items.statement: AI Underwriting Assist reduced SME credit memo prep from 2 days to 20 mins, 30% productivity gain; 85% adoption
items.quote: Our underwriting assist platform, amongst the first in the industry, has reduced credit memo preparation time from 2 days to 20 minutes in our SME business, thereby improving productivity of the underwriting team by 30%.

items.statement: FY28 ROA guided at 2.5-2.7%
items.quote: for FY28, we have guided for an ROA band of 2.5% to 2.7%

items.statement: FY27 loan growth guided at 23-25%
items.quote: given the fact that you're looking at around 23 % to 25% loan growth next year

items.statement: FY28 cost-to-income guided at 33-34%
items.quote: we have said that cost to income should be between 33 to 34% and we do believe that is achievable

items.statement: FY27 credit cost guided at ~1% (down from 1.2% in FY26)
items.quote: we do believe that the right credit cost for us would be some 1% and which is the guidance which we have given

items.statement: FY27 cost of funds expected lower than FY26
items.quote: we do believe that moneys which have been raised in FY26 or some part of FY25 will keep running for FY27 and may not need to be fully replaced and they will remain at the lower cost

items.statement: Housing finance LAP book at INR 17,000-18,000 cr; total LAP ~INR 38,000 cr
items.quote: When I look at the LAP number above, it is somewhere in one of the slides above it's at around INR38,000 crores and the when I look at the Tata Capital Housing, it's at around INR17,000-18,000 crores

items.statement: Clean energy, developer finance, top corporates driving corporate loan growth
items.quote: it would be well spread out. I would say , it's there in clean energy , where there is a lot of demand for credit , where new projects are coming up. It's there in developer finance and it is there in - you name probably the top 10 corporates of the country and half of them will be there

items.statement: Fee income stable at 1.1% of assets in Q3 and Q4 FY26
items.quote: if I look at our overall fee it is the same in quarter three versus quarter four. It was about 1.1% and still remains 1.1%

items.statement: Board approved preferential allotment of equity shares worth ~INR450 crore at SEBI price of INR483 and enabling resolution for INR200 crore debentures
items.quote: To support these initiatives, the Board has approved a preferential allotment of equity shares worth approximately INR450 crore at the SEBI price of INR483, which was the SEBI price on that day. In addition, the Board has approved an enabling resolution for raising debentures of INR200 crore.

items.statement: PLA plant commissioning remains on track for Q3 FY27
items.quote: Rhea Bhatia: Okay, understood. And the PLA plant commissioning, does that remain on track for quarter three? Pramod Patwari: Yes, absolutely.

items.statement: Management acknowledges 10% of PLA cost overrun due to supplier blackmail, but expects no further cost revisions as machinery arriving soon
items.quote: Some are genuine, 90% are genuine, 10% is a bit of blackmail. One has to succumb to that in order to complete the plant with precision.

items.statement: Promoters to participate in fundraise maintaining 43% stake, investing ~INR193 crore of the INR450 crore equity raise
items.quote: We would like to highlight that continued participation from the promoters in the fundraise will keep our stake, the family stake, at 43%. So if you see, we have put in 43% of INR450 crore, which is about INR193 crore.

items.statement: Gypsum board prices have increased 25% recently due to West Asia crisis, potentially reducing payback period below 5 years
items.quote: Given the current disruption, I believe that since we started evaluating this project, the board prices we had factored in have already increased by 25% due to the West Asia crisis.

items.statement: UP bioplastic policy's 50% capital subsidy applies to revised PLA project cost including overrun
items.quote: The document, the policy document, does not curtail your investment and yes, therefore what you have said is absolutely correct.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned at around Rs 250 crores for the company as a whole

items.quote: Because once we have more clarity on the IOC's SM plant commissioning date, then only we will put in the big monies for the PS and EPS.

items.quote: manufacturing operations of the maas ABS plant have restarted with modified arrangements and are currently operating at around 65% of the design capacity, pending restoration of the impacted equipment.

items.statement: Polystyrene GP spreads widened to ~$275/ton vs ~$200/ton pre-war

items.statement: Inventory losses expected when West Asia situation normalizes and styrene prices correct from current elevated levels
items.quote: we are aware that inventory loss might come the moment the whole situation normalizes. So, as and when it happens there will be some inventory loss to us.

items.statement: Non-OEM market shrinking in April as polymer prices fall due to lack of demand
items.quote: April itself, we are seeing now that the market is shrinking as far as non-OEM sector is concerned. So, the prices which went up in the month of March, the prices are coming down.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with investable surplus of INR 700 crores as of March 2026; all capex funded through internal accruals
items.quote: the Company continues to remain debt-free with an investable surplus of INR 700 crores as at the end of March 2026. All capital expenditure continues to be funded through internal accruals.

items.statement: Expect sustained double-digit growth in retail earnings over next phase driven by lease renewals, new mall ramp-up, and expansions
items.quote: we are well positioned for a sustained double-digit growth in retail earnings over the next phase

items.statement: PMC Pune rental income to grow 14-15% and PMC Bangalore 20% in FY27
items.quote: Phoenix MarketCity, Pune, we will see close to 14-15% rental upside in FY27, and PMC Bangalore is going to be close to 20% increase in the rental income

items.statement: Office portfolio occupancy to progress towards 90% over next few quarters with meaningful step-up in rental income and EBITDA from FY27
items.quote: we now have clear visibility on income ramping up and overall occupancy progressing towards 90% over the next few quarters. We expect a meaningful step-up in rental income and EBITDA from FY27 onwards

items.statement: Quarterly office income expected to double from current levels by Q4 FY27
items.quote: I would estimate that our quarterly income from office assets should double from current levels by the time next year Quarter 4 comes around

items.statement: Kolkata and Surat malls targeted for launch in second half of FY28
items.quote: for Kolkata and Surat, we are expecting to launch it during FY28, in the second half of FY28

items.statement: Phoenix Grand Victoria Kolkata 79% leased and Phoenix Surat 41% leased
items.quote: leasing transactions at our under-construction assets remains encouraging, with Phoenix Grand Victoria in Kolkata already at 79% leased and Phoenix Surat at 41% leased

items.quote: Retail EBITDA for FY26 was Rs. 2,246 crore, growing 12% year-on-year. This improvement reflects both strong top-line income growth and operating leverage coming through from disciplined cost management

items.statement: Retail consumption reached all-time high of Rs 16,587 crore, up 21% YoY in FY26; Q4 consumption grew 31%
items.quote: Retail consumption reached an all-time high of Rs. 16,587 crore, growing 21% year-on-year, while Q4 consumption grew 31%

items.statement: 36-50% of portfolio area coming up for renewal over next 2-3 years providing catalyst for rental growth
items.quote: With 36-50% of our portfolio area coming up for renewal over the next 2-3 years, the conversion of consumption growth into rental growth has a clear and near-term catalyst

items.statement: Invested Rs 1,035 crore in construction and development across retail and office assets and Rs 431 crore towards land and development rights in FY26
items.quote: we invested approximately Rs. 1,035 crore in construction and development across retail and office assets, and a further Rs. 431 crore towards land and development rights in existing projects

items.statement: Actively scouting new cities including Hyderabad, Jaipur, Navi Mumbai; expect to announce 1-2 new city expansion transactions in FY27
items.quote: we are actively scouting the cities that we have also put out in our presentation. This includes Hyderabad, Jaipur, Navi Mumbai amongst others. And fingers crossed, we will be announcing one or two transactions during FY27

items.statement: FY27 crane hiring revenue guided at INR 62.5 crores; FY28 guided at INR 95 crores

I cannot comment on that. But currently, our order book is INR 60 crores and above for FY27, financial year.

items.statement: FY26 capex deployed INR 210 crores vs INR 100 crores guidance; targeting INR 400 crores cumulative capex
items.quote: We also significantly outperformed our CapEx guidance of INR 100 crores in FY26 by deploying INR 210 crores of fresh CapEx during this year, resulting in a sharp expansion in our asset base and rental run rate.

items.statement: Monthly gross yield ~3% on machines below 100 tons; cost of borrowing 5% +/- 0.5% flat rate; subvention income reduces effective financing cost
items.quote: Our unit economics remain robust with approximately 3% monthly gross yield at low cost of borrowing, and targeted ROC of 22-25%, which is our strategy to continue to scale up.

items.statement: Strong demand across renewables, railways, industrial capex; daily RFQs for 250-750 ton machines; no slowdown seen; Reliance Kutch 5.5 lakh acre expansion driving crane demand

So currently, the CapEx cycle is going really well.

items.quote: See, currently, I'm talking about that the only issue which we can face is operational challenges. But for now, all our contracts have been extended to 31st December. Over the next eight, nine months, we don't have any problem with the order book.

items.statement: Debt repayment ~2.5% monthly (7.5% quarterly); targeting debt/equity ~1.5x; can borrow INR 100+ crores more as INR 40-45 crores repaid annually
items.quote: So because our tenure of this - yeah that's per month. So on when you see from a month on month perspective, every quarter, we are approximately paying 7.5% of the loan book. So that's very high because in our industry, this is how it works.

items.statement: Fleet grew from 8 machines (FY24) to 140+ machines; gross block INR 258 crores incl. GST; INR 27 crores in CWIP; INR 33 crores GST recoverable
items.quote: We have gone from INR 36 crores of assets to INR 260 crores of assets. So that's a very big jump. Because of that, the cost and all is very difficult to get the exact numbers right now. But now from Q1 FY27, everything will be streamlined again.

items.statement: Land acquisition outflows of Rs 903 crore in FY26 to secure 10,560 crore GDV
items.quote: The land outflows were around 900 crores for the year to get to that GDV of 10,560 crores, but this 903 also includes existing land commitments, which should also be factored in.

items.quote: BD momentum continues, 18,000 crores, including Thane this year as well, and total GDV for more than 45,000 crores.

items.quote: I can verbally tell you, roughly 17% is the portfolio IRR that we're carrying. There are 26 projects that are part of it.

items.statement: FY27 launch pipeline of ~Rs 10,000 crore (Rs 3,000 crore Rainforest + Rs 7,000 crore other launches); 8 OCs planned with 2 already received
items.quote: Yeah, 7 plus 3. 3,000 of rainforest will be this year, the remaining 7,000 for the other 7, 8 launches that we have. So, the inventory launch should be 10,000.

items.statement: Annuity portfolio strategy: mixed-use commercial at Kanjur/Bhandup, Thane, Citadel; targeting Rs 150-200 crore rental income in 4-5 years
items.quote: I think, our desire is to first get to somewhere between 150-200 crore before we put more assets, more capital to develop more commercial assets.

items.statement: Management aims for 30% top-line and 30% bottom-line growth but keeps official guidance at 20-20% to avoid over-promising.
items.quote: Yes I want to achieve that target. But for the comfort of the people like you, our investors, I don't want to over-promise. So let's keep the target at present 20-20%.

items.statement: Content acquisition budget for FY27 is INR 80-90 crores, higher than FY26's ~INR 60 crores.
items.quote: I feel and our budget is more than that. I think we want to spend around INR80 crores, INR90 crores this year. We are trying for that and hopefully we will achieve that.

items.statement: Digital revenue ~70% of total in FY26; non-digital (publishing, public performance, brands) ~30% and growing.

items.quote: Last year it would be around 10% to 12%. It has inched higher for us. The subscription business is growing at around 30% to 40% CAGR. So it has inched higher for us this year.

items.statement: YouTube Shorts views declined but long-form video views grew as expected; no material impact on YouTube Shorts renewal deal.
items.quote: Kavish, we don't see any material impact of this declining views. And as we have said earlier, it happens in one quarter or half a year, one of the Shorts goes viral and the views increase multi-fold.

items.statement: Warner Chappell setting up publishing arm in India is seen as positive for Tips Music.
items.quote: It would be positive, Vishal. They are setting up a business in India, it's a huge positive for us. We won't be able to divulge more details, but it's a good positive.

items.statement: Management is cautious on content acquisitions due to competitive market and risk of overpaying for underperforming content.
items.quote: We are really looking for more content that we should acquire. And we can convince people like you that we can have a maybe less PAT, but actually we are not getting content. I have to match the quality and the price of the content.

items.quote: We have acquired one Gujarati kutchchi channel, kutchchi Music, Gujarati music and where we got 4,000 songs. So we have acquired that. We are open to that and whenever we feel that price is right and we can do that we will do that.

items.quote: No, no, this won't be the new run rate. At every Q4 we make a provision for increment. So this quarter, basis the performance, the provision is on the higher side. But otherwise, if you see, the overall count of employees has reduced from 105 to 98.

items.statement: Fee income to assets at 1.4% structurally sustainable; medium-term target 1.5-1.6% via branch cross-sell
items.quote: I see good headroom for them to over-index on to take this to 1.5 - 1.6. But beyond that, in the medium term would be a little too stretched.

items.statement: Credit cost guidance maintained at 1.3-1.7% range for FY27; FY26 closed at 1.7% including overlay
items.quote: We have always said that our business model should factor or stomach 1.3 to 1.7. We are confident to stay within that.

items.statement: Tractor momentum continuing but base effect may moderate YoY growth; used vehicle and passenger vehicle growing strongly
items.quote: We see that momentum continuing into this year. Of course, since the denominator is quite high, we may not see the same YoY growth of what we demonstrated last year because the base is higher.

items.statement: AI/digital investments continuing across collections, back-office (SamurAI), and front-office; mix of capex and opex
items.quote: Yes, yes. Some of it is capex, some of it is OPEX.

items.statement: Incremental cost of funds elevated in April vs March; difficult to predict trajectory due to mixed borrowing instruments
items.quote: After March, we have seen certain spike in the capital market rates in the month of April. And still the uncertainty is ongoing. So it's very difficult to predict the overall change.

items.statement: Borrowings of INR 35,000-40,000 crores maturing in next 1 year; weighted average cost not disclosed
items.quote: INR 35,000 crores to INR 40,000 crores.

items.quote: We expect the deposit repricing benefit to come till late Q2, perhaps early Q3. That's it, not beyond that, okay?

items.quote: As of now, we're sticking to the below 45 bps, okay? We don't see -- currently, we are at 32, 33 bps. I don't see us in the short term, getting -- increasing anywhere around the 45 basis points mark.

items.statement: Cost-to-average assets guided at 2.5% for FY27 despite headcount increase to ~13,000
items.quote: Model suggest 2.5% of cost to average assets. Reality, we are slightly better than that. And we're very happy at 2.5%.

items.statement: Asset growth guidance of 18-20% maintained for FY27 despite macro uncertainty
items.quote: I think 18%, 20% is a given.

items.quote: On net interest margin, the uptick continues, 3.39%, which we recorded in Q4 is 12 basis points higher than the sequential quarter and 10 basis points higher than the previous period -- in the same period last year.

items.quote: We should be in the next 2, 3 quarters or next 2 quarters maybe, right, maybe either late Q2 or early Q3, we should be going in for a fundraise.

items.quote: Cost of deposit in Q4 is 44 basis points lower this year as compared to Q4 of last year.

items.statement: Expect more than 1,000 keys to be added in FY27, highest ever annual addition
items.quote: And I think as we go into F '27, we are looking to build on this and we expect more than 1,000 keys to be added in F '27.

items.quote: On a very small base of about 100 rooms transformation or renovation which we did, we do have plans to invest or move that number at least by, say, 3x in F '27.

items.quote: Ganpatipule should we should be going live by quarter 3 of this year.
